newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM, Dutch shippers agree code of conduct.
newsitem.headline: KLM, Dutch shippers agree code of conduct.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines Cargo and EVO, the Dutch shippers organisation, have signed a far-reaching code of conduct, the two said in a statement.

Both are hoping that the agreement will be a general code of conduct for all the Dutch airfreight sector. The main aim is to more clearly define the different functions faced by both sides, industry sources said.
KLM Cargo has promised Dutch shippers to give them ample time between the publication of changes and their implementation.
This was a key shipper demand following the imposition in late 1997 at short notice of an air cargo fuel surcharge, the sources added.

The statement said both sides agreed on the need for quality improvements in some airfreight sectors and for increased transparency. Under the agreement there is also scope for consultations on supply and demand developments. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
